pages.text: ImmortalStorage begins with two ores. $(item)Spirit Iron$() forms structures and tools; $(item)Spirit Crystal$() forms cores and advanced processes. Mine, refine, then combine them into a Spirit Core—the thread running through nearly every device.

pages.title: Spirit Iron Ore
pages.text: Stone and deepslate Spirit Iron follow vanilla iron-ore generation. Mining yields Crude Spirit Iron. A blast furnace refines it in 100 ticks; an Immortal Furnace needs 50.

pages.title: Spirit Crystal Ore
pages.text: Stone and deepslate Spirit Crystal follow vanilla diamond-ore generation. Mining yields Spirit Crystals directly. An Immortal Furnace can also refine silk-touched ore blocks for bulk processing.

pages.heading: Refining Crude Spirit Iron
pages.body: Stone and deepslate Spirit Iron ores have matching blast-furnace recipes. The furnace catalogue shows the faster Immortal Furnace routes.

pages.title: Spirit Iron Compression
pages.text: Nine ingots form a block; one block returns all nine.

pages.title: Spirit Crystal Compression
pages.text: Nine crystals form a block and can be recovered in full.

pages.title: Crude Spirit Iron Compression
pages.text: Unrefined material may be stored compactly without loss.

pages.title: Spirit Iron Nuggets
pages.text: One ingot becomes nine nuggets and nine return one ingot. Nuggets appear in the Substitute Puppet, Miniature Ruin and Xianeng Electricity Crystal.

pages.title: Spirit Core
pages.text: Spirit Iron, Spirit Crystals and an Amethyst Shard form the Spirit Core. It stacks to 16 and serves as the common hinge between machines, weapons and advanced smithing.

pages.title: Where Next
pages.text: See $(l:immortalstorage:recipes/immortal_furnace_processes)Immortal Furnace Catalogue$(/l) for every furnace process, or $(l:immortalstorage:recipes/nurturing_crystal)The Nurturing Crystal Chain$(/l) for crystal growth and Heavy Cores.
